module: Attention marker for a parking spot: draws in debug (debugDrawer:drawTriSolid) the four translucent blue walls (alpha 25%) of a box around the spot, height 1.33 m, double-sided. No scene object is created. The module returns a constructor: require('scenario/raceMarkers/parkingAttention')(id) gives an object of class C.
notes: setToCheckpoint(wp) accepts either wp = {pos, rot, scl} (center, quaternion, full size of the spot), or wp.parkingSpot with these three fields; otherwise only wp.pos and wp.radius are stored and nothing is drawn.
The color is fixed (0, 0.4, 1) regardless of the mode.
The extracted page shows update(dtSim); the actual signature is update(dt, dtSim).

C.desc: Debug walls around a parking spot.

update.desc: Per-frame call: advances the mode timer, hides after the fade in 'hidden', and draws the four walls if a spot is defined.

setToCheckpoint.desc: Stores the parking spot to surround.

createMarkers.desc: Kept for API compatibility with the other markers: creates no object.
